title: Passquessit (East End of Fishers Island)
summary: Passquessit is a placename for the east end of Fishers Island, an adjacent island in the Town of Southold.
map_geometry_source: Approximate modern east-end Fishers Island point based on Tooker location; not an exact historical boundary coordinate.
introduction_content: Passquessit is connected with the east end of Fishers Island, a high bluffed landscape at the eastern entrance of Long Island Sound.
history_content: The placename belongs to the eastern end of Fishers Island rather than the island as a whole. Details appear in the historic moments below.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as at the place where it rises or stands up, reflecting the high hills and bluffs at the east end of the island. A reconstructed form is Passuqu-es-et.

Why Place Names Matter

“Every place name has a story behind it, of how it came to be.”

— Luise Hercus, Authenticity in Toponymy (2018), opening discussion
whereintheworld_content: Approximate/general point near the east end of Fishers Island in the Town of Southold. This is not an exact historical boundary coordinate.
